subject: general
question: In a circle, there are two parallel chords of lengths 10 cm and 24 cm. Both chords are situated on the same side of the center. If the distance between them is 7 cm, find the area of the circle.
solution:
**Given:**

Chord 1 = 10 cm

Chord 2 = 24 cm

Distance between chords = 7 cm

**Formula Used:**

Chord length = 2 × √(r² − d²)

Area of circle = πr²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/164602d73adbbcd2640acafc3aeddab42f96b7fd8e05596a5795d42dd21d5bbe.png] 

⇒ 10 = 2 × √(r² − d₁²)

⇒ 5 = √(r² − d₁²)

⇒ r² − d₁² = 25

⇒ 24 = 2 × √(r² − d₂²)

⇒ 12 = √(r² − d₂²)

⇒ r² − d₂² = 144

⇒ d₁ − d₂ = 7

⇒ r² − (d₂ + 7)² = 25

⇒ r² − (d₂² + 14d₂ + 49) = 25

⇒ r² − d₂² − 14d₂ − 49 = 25

⇒ 144 − 14d₂ − 49 = 25

⇒ 95 − 14d₂ = 25

⇒ 70 = 14d₂

⇒ d₂ = 5

⇒ r² − 5² = 144

⇒ r² − 25 = 144

⇒ r² = 169

⇒ r = 13

⇒ Area = π × 13²

⇒ 169π

**∴ The correct answer is 169π.**
